entities.summary: David De Gruttola, known by his pseudonym David Cage, is a French video game designer, writer and musician. He is the founder of the game development studio Quantic Dream. Cage wrote and directed Heavy Rain, Beyond: Two Souls, and Detroit: Become Human.
